chart.title: Wildfire area burned by land cover type
chart.subtitle: Total area of forests, savannas, shrublands/grasslands, croplands, and other land that have been burned as a result of [wildfires](#dod:wildfires) each year.

Yearly burned area across other land cat.descriptionShort: Total area of land categories other than forests, savannas, shrublands/grasslands and croplands burnt by [wildfires](#dod:wildfires) in hectares.
descriptionKey: Wildfires are detected through the use of satellite imagery based on the NASA MCD64 MODIS product which offers global assessments of burned areas and fire occurrences. Although widely used, this product is known to consistently underestimate both the extent of burned areas and the frequency of fires. However, in terms of historical trends, it stands out as the most comprehensive dataset, offering the longest time series compared to other available options.
Yearly burned area across other land cat.citationShort: Global Wildfire Information System (2022) – with minor processing by Our World in Data
Yearly burned area across other land cat.citationLong: Global Wildfire Information System (2022) – with minor processing by Our World in Data. “Other land” [dataset]. Global Wildfire Information System, “Global Monthly Burned Area” [original data].
